text.praiseToYou: All: Praise to you, Lord Jesus Christ.
text.intentionSuffix: Let us pray to the Lord.

templates.title: Placeholder - Ordinary Time
templates.priestInvitation: Let us bring our needs before the Lord, who hears every prayer.
intentions: For the Church, that she may be a sign of hope for all people, let us pray to the Lord.
For those who govern, that they may serve the common good, let us pray to the Lord.
For our school community, that our work and study may give glory to God, let us pray to the Lord.
For the sick and the suffering, that they may know God’s comfort, let us pray to the Lord.
For the faithful departed, that they may rest in peace, let us pray to the Lord.
templates.priestConclusion: Father, hear the prayers of your people and grant what we ask in faith. Through Christ our Lord.

templates.title: Placeholder - Advent
templates.priestInvitation: As we wait in joyful hope, let us place our needs before the Lord.
intentions: For the Church, that she may prepare the way of the Lord, let us pray to the Lord.
For all who wait in darkness, that they may see the light of Christ, let us pray to the Lord.
For our community, that this season may find us watchful, let us pray to the Lord.
For the faithful departed, that they may see the Lord’s face, let us pray to the Lord.
templates.priestConclusion: God of hope, hear the prayers of your waiting people. Through Christ our Lord.

templates.title: Placeholder - Lent
templates.priestInvitation: Turning back to the Lord with all our heart, let us pray.
responseOptions: Have mercy on us, O Lord.
intentions: For the Church, that this season may renew her, let us pray to the Lord.
For those preparing for baptism, that they may be strengthened, let us pray to the Lord.
For the hungry and the homeless, that we may not pass them by, let us pray to the Lord.
For ourselves, that our fasting may become mercy, let us pray to the Lord.
templates.priestConclusion: Merciful Father, hear the prayers of your people this season. Through Christ our Lord.
